about: The source model of an MRC2014 file (spec/virtualize/mrc.md §5.3 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/virtualize/mrc.md#53-elements>): the elements a parser emits, the table of modes, and the roles the file, its byte order, its dimensions, its mode, its extended header, a volume stack and its data play, each with the constraints a file must meet to have the MRC convention's layout (spec/virtualize/mrc.md §14.1 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/virtualize/mrc.md#141-header>). The parser checks them in this order; projections read a valid IR and check nothing.

modes.about: mode: Zarr data type, bytes per voxel; a mode 0 file with IMOD's stamp (1146047817 at byte 152) and bit 0 of its flags (byte 156) set is uint8 instead

unsupported.about: modes the profile names and rejects

elements.about: The IR of an MRC file. E is the file's byte order (< or >), n the extended header's length (nsymbt), B the data's size.

header.type: the 1024-byte header as one record, a field per field of spec/virtualize/mrc.md §2 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/virtualize/mrc.md#2-the-header> in its order: numbers Ei4, Ef4 (arrays for T[k]), u1[4] for machst, bytes[k] for the extra space, cstr[k] for text, and {text:cstr[80]}[10] for the labels

extended.extent: (1024, n), when n > 0: the extended header, opaque

constraints.message: file too short for a 1024-byte MRC header
the {nsymbt}-byte extended header at 1024 is outside the {size}-byte file
a volume stack (ispg {ispg}) of {nz} sections, which mz = {mz} does not divide

given.total: B = nx * ny * nz * b, exactly

constraints.message: the {total_shown}-byte data at {offset} is outside the {size}-byte file
